mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_instances (id, application_id, source_event_id, tenant_id, process_definition_key, status, current_task, version, created_at) VALUES (#{id, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{sourceEventId, jdbcType=OTHER}, #{tenantId}, #{processDefinitionKey}, #{status}, #{currentTask}, #{version}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, source_event_id, tenant_id, process_definition_key, status, current_task, version, created_at FROM workflow_instances WHERE application_id = #{applicationId, jdbcType=OTHER}
